card.name: Verbs of harming or hindering
card.fires_on: Verbs (or their word parts) meaning to harm, hinder or damage something, where a harmful cause is about to be followed by the thing it affects. Seen in news, science and religious web text.

modes.description: A verb saying something damages, threatens or hurts a thing.

modes.label: Harm-related words
modes.description: Nouns or prepositions in a harm setting, such as damage, illness or sinned against.
modes.example: Sinkholes can swallow up earth in an instant and cause<< damage>> or even worse.
